payload.title: Analytical global lower bound for uniform 2x2 binary CHSH
payload.definitions: For each deterministic strategy define d_x=c_x A_a B_b. There are either one or three negative d_x values. Let J be the exceptional location and R=+1 for one mismatch, R=-1 for three mismatches. Then d_x=R(1-2*1[x=J]).
payload.proof_route: U=(J,R) is a deterministic function of Lambda, so data processing gives I(Lambda;X)>=I(U;X). A relative-entropy variational inequality and Jensen yield I(Lambda;X)>=1/ln(2)*[beta*S/4-ln((3e^beta+e^-beta)/4)]. Optimizing beta gives the candidate lower bound.
payload.conclusion: Analytical global minimum established for the stated finite model: uniform settings, two settings per party, binary outcomes, 16 deterministic local strategies and the stated CHSH constraint. This is not a proof of a physical superdeterministic mechanism.
